checks: the explicit website_chat API receives one JSON payload without credentials or UI events
verified context preserves model identifiers and omits customer contact records
large multi-region context stays valid JSON below 16000 characters with full totals and excerpt limits
website scenario results reach the Space without changing regional planning records
conversation history contains complete recent user/assistant pairs only
SSE parsing handles heartbeat, CRLF, Unicode and split response frames
interface text, empty answers, incompatible shapes and explicit provider errors are rejected
error events, malformed SSE and premature stream completion cannot become AI answers
fabricated report references cause a clear local-fallback error
access restrictions, sleeping Space and rate limits return useful connection messages
connection testing checks the actual JSON contract without consuming model inference
stopped and timed-out requests cancel transport without submitting another analysis
MK uses the Space through the chat UI and includes regional facts plus follow-up history

method: Offline Node.js transport tests and jsdom DOM simulations; no browser or live inference in this script.
